description: Manage your home service business with Housecall Pro CRM integration

auth.description: Your Housecall Pro API Key. You can find it in your Housecall Pro account settings under API.

create_customer.name: create_customer
create_customer.description: Creates a new customer in Housecall Pro.

info.description: At least one of: First Name, Last Name, Email, Mobile Number, Home Number, Work Number is required.

tags.description: Array of tags to assign to the customer

aiMetadata.description: Create a new Housecall Pro customer record with contact details, tags, and optional inline addresses. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate customer, so repeating it can produce duplicates. At least one of first name, last name, email, mobile/home/work number is required. To change an existing customer use Update Customer.

get_customers.name: get_customers
get_customers.description: Retrieves a list of customers from Housecall Pro.

q.description: Search customers by name, email, mobile number, and address

location_ids.description: IDs of locations from which to pull customers

sort_by.description: The customer attribute by which to sort the results

sort_direction.description: The order of sorting (ascending or descending)

aiMetadata.description: List Housecall Pro customers with optional full-text search (name, email, mobile, address), location filtering, sorting, and pagination. Read-only and idempotent. Use the q search query to locate a customer by name or contact details before referencing their ID in other actions.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Fetch one Housecall Pro customer by its customer ID, optionally expanding attachments and do-not-service status. Read-only and repeatable. Requires a known customer ID; it does not search by name or email.

update_customer.name: update_customer
update_customer.description: Updates an existing customer in Housecall Pro.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to update.

tags.description: Array of tags to assign to the customer (replaces existing tags)

addresses.description: Array of address objects (if provided, each address must include an id)

aiMetadata.description: Update fields on an existing Housecall Pro customer identified by customer ID; only supplied fields change. Effectively idempotent because it targets a stable ID, but note that providing tags replaces the existing tag set rather than appending. To create a new customer use Create Customer instead.

get_customer_addresses.name: get_customer_addresses
get_customer_addresses.displayName: Get All of a Customer's Addresses
get_customer_addresses.description: Retrieves all of a customer's addresses.

page_size.description: Number of addresses returned per page

aiMetadata.description: List all addresses belonging to a given Housecall Pro customer, with pagination and sorting by created/updated time. Read-only and repeatable. Requires a known customer ID.

create_customer_address.name: create_customer_address
create_customer_address.displayName: Create an Address on a Customer
create_customer_address.description: Creates an address on a customer.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to add address to

aiMetadata.description: Add a new address to an existing Housecall Pro customer. Not idempotent: each call creates another address on the customer, so repeating can produce duplicates. Street, city, state, zip, and country are required.

get_customer_address.name: get_customer_address
get_customer_address.description: Retrieves a customer's address by customer ID and address ID.

aiMetadata.description: Read-only: fetches a single customer address in Housecall Pro by its customer ID and address ID. Use when both IDs are known and you need the details of one specific address; safe to retry. Does not list all addresses for a customer and does not modify any data.

create_job.name: create_job
create_job.description: Creates a job with the ID for an already existing address and customer.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer this job is for

address_id.description: The ID of the address for this job

invoice_number.description: Invoice number must be unique across all of a company's jobs. If left blank, one will be automatically generated.

scheduled_start.description: Start time of job in ISO8601 format (e.g., 2021-01-14T20:14:00)

scheduled_end.description: End time of job in ISO8601 format (e.g., 2021-01-14T21:14:00)

arrival_window.description: Integer value in minutes of arrival window

assigned_employee_ids.description: Array of employee IDs to assign to the job

tags.description: Array of tags to assign to the job

line_items.description: Array of line items for the job

pricing_form.description: Pricing form object with fields and options (use UUIDs from GET price form endpoint)

aiMetadata.description: Create a new Housecall Pro job for an existing customer and address, with optional schedule, assigned employees, tags, line items, and pricing/job fields. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate job. Requires existing customer ID and address ID; the customer and address must be created first.

get_jobs.name: get_jobs
get_jobs.description: Retrieve a list of jobs from Housecall Pro.

customer_id.description: Filters jobs by a single customer ID

employee_ids.description: Array of employee IDs to filter jobs

expand.description: Array of strings to expand response body

location_ids.description: IDs of locations to retrieve jobs from

page_size.description: The number of jobs returned per page

scheduled_start_min.description: Filters jobs with a starting time greater than or equal to the date sent

scheduled_start_max.description: Filters jobs with a starting time less than or equal to the date sent

scheduled_end_min.description: Filters jobs with an end time greater than or equal to the date sent

scheduled_end_max.description: Filters jobs with an end time less than or equal to the date sent

sort_by.description: The attribute to sort the results by

work_status.description: Filters jobs by their work status. If empty, returns jobs from all statuses

aiMetadata.description: List or search Housecall Pro jobs with optional filters (customer, employees, locations, scheduled date ranges, work status) plus pagination and sorting. Read-only and repeatable. Use to discover jobs matching criteria; when you already have a single job ID, use Get a Job instead.

get_job.name: get_job
get_job.description: Retrieves a single job by ID from Housecall Pro.

job_id.description: The ID of the job to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Fetch one Housecall Pro job by its job ID, optionally expanding attachments and/or appointments. Read-only and repeatable. Use when you already have a job ID; to discover jobs by customer, status, or date range use Get Jobs instead.

update_job_schedule.name: update_job_schedule
update_job_schedule.description: Updates a job's schedule. Jobs with multi days feature containing more than 1 appointment can't be updated through this action.

job_id.description: The ID of the job to update schedule for

start_time.description: Start time of job in ISO8601 format (e.g., 2021-01-14T20:14:00)

end_time.description: End time of job in ISO8601 format (e.g., 2021-01-14T21:14:00)

arrival_window_in_minutes.description: Integer value in minutes of arrival window

notify.description: Notify the customer of the update schedule

notify_pro.description: Notify the pros of the update schedule

dispatched_employees.description: Array of employee objects with employee_id

aiMetadata.description: Overwrites the schedule (start time, end time, arrival window, dispatched employees) of an existing Housecall Pro job, identified by job ID. Use to reschedule or re-dispatch a single-appointment job; not idempotent since it mutates the job and can trigger customer/pro notifications on each call. Cannot update multi-day jobs that contain more than one appointment.

job_id.description: The ID of the job to delete schedule from.

aiMetadata.description: Remove the schedule (start/end times) from a Housecall Pro job by job ID, leaving the job itself intact. Idempotent: deleting an already-unscheduled job's schedule has no further effect.

create_job_appointment.name: create_job_appointment
create_job_appointment.description: Add an appointment to a job

start_time.description: Start time of job appointment in iso8601

end_time.description: End time of job appointment in iso8601

arrival_window_minutes.description: Integer value in minutes of arrival window

dispatched_employees_ids.description: List of pros ids to be assign in appointment

aiMetadata.description: Add a new appointment to a Housecall Pro job, specifying start/end times, the dispatched-employee list, and an optional arrival window. Not idempotent: repeated calls create duplicate appointments on the job. Use update-appointment to modify an existing appointment instead.

get_job_appointments.name: get_job_appointments
get_job_appointments.description: Get all of the appointments for a job

aiMetadata.description: List all appointments scheduled on a Housecall Pro job identified by job ID. Read-only and idempotent. Use create-appointment or update-appointment to modify scheduling.

start_time.description: Start time of job appointment in iso8601

end_time.description: End time of job appointment in iso8601

arrival_window_minutes.description: Integer value in minutes of arrival window

dispatched_employees_ids.description: List of pros ids to be assign in appointment

aiMetadata.description: Update an existing appointment on a Housecall Pro job, replacing its start/end times, dispatched-employee list, and optional arrival window. Requires both the job ID and the appointment ID. Idempotent: re-applying the same values yields the same appointment state. Use create-appointment to add a new appointment rather than modify one.

Permanently delete an appointment from a Housecall Pro job, identified by job ID and appointment ID. Idempotent on the target since the appointment ends up gone; a repeat call on an already-deleted appointment simply has no further effect. Destructive and not reversible.

add_job_note.name: add_job_note
add_job_note.description: Add a note to a job

aiMetadata.description: Append a text note to a Housecall Pro job by job ID. Not idempotent: each call adds another note, so repeating it creates duplicate notes.

note_id.description: The ID of the note to delete

aiMetadata.description: Delete a single note from a Housecall Pro job, identified by job ID and note ID. Idempotent: deleting an already-removed note has no further effect.

add_job_attachment.name: add_job_attachment
add_job_attachment.displayName: Add an attachment to a job
add_job_attachment.description: Upload an attachment to a job

job_id.description: The ID of the job to add attachment to

aiMetadata.description: Upload a file attachment to a Housecall Pro job identified by job ID, sent as multipart form data. Not idempotent: repeated calls add duplicate attachments.

add_job_line_item.description: Add a line item to a job. This is a rate limited request.

name.description: The name of the line item

description.description: The description of the line item

unit_price.description: The unit price of the line item

unit_cost.description: The unit cost of the line item

tax_surcharge_type.description: The type of tax or surcharge

taxable.description: Whether the line item is taxable

aiMetadata.description: Append a single line item (name plus optional price, cost, quantity, kind, and tax settings) to a Housecall Pro job. Not idempotent: each call adds another line item, so repeating it creates duplicates. This endpoint is rate limited. To change an existing line item use Update a single line item for a job.

update_job_line_item.name: update_job_line_item
update_job_line_item.displayName: Update a single line item for a job
update_job_line_item.description: Update a specific line item for a job

id.description: The ID of the line item

service_line_id.description: The ID of the service line

name.description: The name of the line item

unit_price.description: The unit price of the line item

unit_cost.description: The unit cost of the line item

quantity.description: The number of items being sold

taxable.description: Whether the line item is taxable

description.description: The description of the line item

aiMetadata.description: Update fields on an existing line item of a Housecall Pro job, identified by job ID and line item ID; only supplied fields change. Idempotent because it targets a stable line item ID. To add a new line item use Add a line item to a job instead.

delete_job_line_item.name: delete_job_line_item
delete_job_line_item.displayName: Delete a single line item for a job
delete_job_line_item.description: Delete a specific line item from a job

id.description: The ID of the line item to delete

aiMetadata.description: Destructive: permanently removes one line item from a Housecall Pro job, identified by the job ID and line item ID. Use only when you intend to delete that specific item; not safe to blindly retry, as a repeat call after success will error because the item no longer exists. Affects only the named line item, not the whole job.

get_job_line_items.name: get_job_line_items
get_job_line_items.displayName: Lists all line items for a job
get_job_line_items.description: Retrieve all line items for a specific job

aiMetadata.description: List every line item (services, materials, charges) on a Housecall Pro job identified by job ID. Read-only and idempotent. Use bulk-update-job-line-items to modify these line items.

add_job_tag.name: add_job_tag
add_job_tag.description: Add a tag to a job

tag_id.description: The ID of the tag to add

aiMetadata.description: Attach a tag (by tag ID) to a Housecall Pro job. Effectively idempotent since adding a tag already present leaves the job's tag set unchanged. To detach a tag use Remove job tag.

remove_job_tag.name: remove_job_tag
remove_job_tag.description: Remove a tag from a job

tag_id.description: The ID of the tag to remove

aiMetadata.description: Detach a tag (by tag ID) from a Housecall Pro job. Effectively idempotent since removing a tag that is not present leaves the job's tag set unchanged. To attach a tag use Add job tag.
Attach a titled hyperlink (title + URL) to a Housecall Pro job identified by job ID. Not idempotent: repeated calls add duplicate links to the job.

get_job_invoices.name: get_job_invoices
get_job_invoices.description: Lists all invoices for a job

job_id.description: The ID of the job to retrieve invoices for

aiMetadata.description: Read-only: returns the invoices attached to a Housecall Pro job, given a job ID. Use to inspect billing/invoice records for a known job before reading or reconciling them; safe to retry. Requires the job_id; does not create or modify invoices.

get_job_input_materials.name: get_job_input_materials
get_job_input_materials.displayName: Lists all job input materials for a job
get_job_input_materials.description: Retrieve all job input materials for a specific job

aiMetadata.description: Read-only: lists all input materials recorded on a Housecall Pro job, given a job ID. Use to inspect the materials/line costs logged against a known job; safe to retry. Requires the job_id and does not add or change materials.

bulk_update_job_line_items.name: bulk_update_job_line_items
bulk_update_job_line_items.displayName: Bulk update a job's line items
bulk_update_job_line_items.description: Bulk update job line items. If upsert not define for a line item it will be considered as a new line item for the job.

line_items.description: Array of line items to update

append_line_items.description: Append line items to the job

aiMetadata.description: Bulk replace or upsert the line items on a Housecall Pro job in a single call. Line items carrying a stable identifier are upserted in place; those without are added as new, so the result is only idempotent when every item is keyed for upsert. Set append_line_items to add to existing items rather than replacing the set. Use get-job-line-items first to read current items.

bulk_update_job_input_materials.name: bulk_update_job_input_materials
bulk_update_job_input_materials.displayName: Bulk update a job's input materials
bulk_update_job_input_materials.description: Bulk update job input materials. If upsert not define for a job input material it will be consider as a new entry.

job_input_materials.description: Array of job input materials to update

aiMetadata.description: Upsert a job's input materials in bulk for a given job ID. Entries that supply an existing material ID are updated; entries without one are created as new, so omitting IDs on a repeat call will add duplicates rather than no-op.

job_id.description: The ID of the job to dispatch

dispatched_employees.description: Array of employees with employee_id to dispatch to

aiMetadata.description: Dispatch a Housecall Pro job to a set of employees, identified by job ID and an array of employee IDs. The call sets the dispatched employees for the job, so re-sending the same list is idempotent.

lock_job.name: lock_job
lock_job.description: Lock the job identified by the given job_id

job_id.description: The ID of the job to lock

aiMetadata.description: Lock a Housecall Pro job by its job ID, preventing further edits. Targets a stable job ID, so re-running on an already-locked job is harmless.

lock_jobs.name: lock_jobs
lock_jobs.description: Lock completed or scheduled jobs by the given time range

starting_at.description: Lock jobs starting from this date/time

aiMetadata.description: Bulk-lock all completed or scheduled Housecall Pro jobs falling within a start/end datetime range, preventing further edits to them. Effectively idempotent: re-running the same range re-locks already-locked jobs with no additional effect. Acts on every matching job in the window, not a single job.

estimate_number.description: Unique estimate number. If blank, one will be automatically generated.

address.description: Address object with fields: street, street_line_2, city, state, zip

schedule.description: Schedule object with fields: start_time, end_time, arrival_window_in_minutes, notify_customer

estimate_fields.description: Estimate fields object with: job_type_id, business_unit_id

options.description: Each option object corresponds to an estimate option to create.

additional_fields.description: Advanced: provide raw fields merged into the request body.

aiMetadata.description: Create a new Housecall Pro estimate, optionally attaching it to an existing customer, address, schedule, and one or more priced options. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate estimate even with identical inputs unless you supply your own unique estimate_number. Use the dedicated address/schedule/estimate-fields objects when known; the additional_fields object merges raw fields into the request body for anything not surfaced as a prop.

sort_by.description: The attribute to sort the results by

work_status.description: Filters estimates by their work status

delete_estimate_option_note.name: delete_estimate_option_note
delete_estimate_option_note.description: Delete a specific estimate option note

aiMetadata.description: Delete a single note from an estimate option, identified by estimate ID, option ID, and note ID. Idempotent: deleting an already-removed note has no further effect.

create_estimate_option_attachment.name: create_estimate_option_attachment
